title: New part of mall unlocked
content: Last night when I visited the mall I was walking thru what I assumed was a food court bright lights white tile and buisnesses lined the outer edges with tables and like planter areas with trees and flower amd looking straight ahead i saw a place that i think said Affordable dentistry. The guy behind the counter was wearing a blue shirt and he had black hair not real long but could brush it back with fingers. There were way more people there but he was the only one who stood out to me...
